thePageIsGeneratedLocally: The page is generated locally and added to your input deck.
enterThePdfSOpen: Enter the PDF’s open (user) password or owner password. It stays in this browser and is needed to preview and include the pages.
selectTextOnADigital: Select text on a digital PDF page, or draw over any area. Scanned pages can be marked by drawing.
noSelectablePdfTextDetected: No selectable PDF text detected. Use Draw area for scanned or image pages.
redactedPdfPagesAreRasterized: Redacted PDF pages are rasterized on export so hidden text beneath a blackout is not retained.
editsApplyToThisOutput: Edits apply to this output page only.
thisDocumentCouldNotBe: This document could not be separated into pages.
yourUploadedPagesWillAppear: Your uploaded pages will appear here in source order.
dragPagesToReorderPin: Drag pages to reorder. Pin any page to give it a title in your linked contents.
createALinkedTableOf: Create a linked table of contents:
noOutputPagesRemainReturn: No output pages remain. Return to selection to add pages.
theseSettingsApplyWhenThe: These settings apply when the finished PDF is created.
filenameOnlySeparateFromPdf: Filename only; separate from PDF properties below.
numberFormatAndCoverSkipping: Number format and cover skipping are ignored while numbering is off.
useForACoverPage: Use for a cover page: it hides only that page’s footer/header number. Later pages keep their actual output page numbers (for example, page 2 remains “Page 2 of 5”).
onlyRasterInputsAreRecompressed: Only raster inputs are recompressed. Original PDF pages remain vector-based; a size goal cannot be guaranteed.
passwordProtectionTurnsEveryPage: Password protection turns every page into an image: text in the final PDF can no longer be selected or searched, and links (including the contents page) stop working.
controlsRestrictionsBelowIfOmitted: Controls restrictions below. If omitted, the open password is also used as owner password.
passwordProtectionReEncodesPages: Password protection re-encodes pages as images. Text will no longer be searchable/selectable, and clickable contents links are removed.
createTheFinishedPdfFrom: Create the finished PDF from the pages above, then download it to your device. Your source files stay in this browser.
